replace_if_match_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string based on a condition. It checks if the substring matches a pattern, and if it does, replaces it with another substring. The full string is split by a delimiter before the replacement operation.

replace_concat_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces a concatenated substring with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

vowel_or_check :: tsubstr
(regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' (regex_or 'o' 'u'))))
description: A function that checks if a character is a vowel (a, e, i, o, u) using logical OR operations.

replace_concat_end_with :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring based on certain conditions. It concatenates the full string with the first substring, then reverses and removes the last two characters before appending the second substring.

replace_end_with_substr :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_end_with_empty_string :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with an empty string after splitting by an empty string delimiter.

replace_each_substr_with_transformed_substr :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces each substring in a full string with a transformed version of the substring based on a provided transformation function. The full string is split by a delimiter before the replacement operation.

replace_if_match_concat_with_a :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string with a concatenated string if a certain condition is met. The condition is checking if the substring matches a specific pattern, and if it does, the substring is replaced with the concatenation of 'a' and another substring.

replace_if_contains_p_with_given_substr :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match 'p' $0) $1 $0)) (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that replaces any occurrence of the character 'p' in a full string with a specified substring. It splits the full string by an empty string delimiter and applies the replacement based on the condition of finding 'p'.

replace_start_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
